text: The utilities' bin/ symlinks arrive as SYMLINKS, not as dereferenced copies, and doctor's manifest check (install_manifest_check, opt/utilz/lib/trees.sh) names a bin/<name> that arrived as a copy as not-a-link, and a link that names another target as retargeted. Every link names the same five characters, 'utilz': dispatch keys on basename $0, so the links are told apart by their PATH. THE SYMLINKS ARE THE DISPATCH PREDICATE: bin/utilz dispatches only when -L "$UTILZ_HOME/bin/$UTIL_NAME" holds, so a utility whose link did not arrive does not dispatch at all. The manifest records each file's checksum, a link's as its target's (devbin's T3 manifest).
